name: ScanNet: Richly-Annotated 3D Reconstructions of Indoor Scenes
description: ScanNet is an RGB-D video dataset containing 1,513 scans of 707 distinct indoor spaces reconstructed into 3D meshes with 2.5 million view frames. Published at CVPR 2017 by Stanford University, Princeton University, and Technical University of Munich (TUM), it features dense 3D surface reconstructions, camera poses, and fine-grained 3D instance and semantic segmentations.
